titles.title: O Come Let Us Adore Him

verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
O come let us adore Him,
O come let us adore Him,
O come let us adore Him,
Christ the Lord.

verse.name: v2a
verse.lines:
You are seated on a throne of praise
Unto You alone let our voices raise
(x2)

verse.name: v2b
verse.lines:
The highest praise is Yours
The highest praise is Yours
The highest praise is Yours
In all the earth
